verses.translation: Verily, We have granted you (O Muhammad ()) Al-Kauthar (a river in Paradise);
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.translation: Therefore turn in prayer to your Lord and sacrifice (to Him only).
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali

verses.translation: For he who makes you angry (O Muhammad ()), – he will be cut off (from every good thing in this world and in the Hereafter).
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan & Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali
